execution: Current-session independent Codex agents; not an application model API
blinding: Fresh-context executors received the frozen Skill/protocol and assigned inputs only; no expectations, evaluator feedback, prior outputs or production access.
attemptPolicy: First written output per case retained; no repair before scoring.
review: Cross-group review: B reviewed A, C reviewed B, A reviewed C. Reviewers read frozen inputs, outputs and rubric and did not modify outputs.
archiveNote: Machine score 9/12 and semantic score 8/12 are both preserved. Later Skill/rubric hardening is documented in grading-erratum.json.
